+import types
+
+import toolz
+import tlz._build_tlz as builder
+
+
+def test_existing_exports_survive_population(monkeypatch):
+    fast = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.audit')
+    slow = types.ModuleType('toolz.audit')
+    fast.__package__ = 'cytoolz.audit'
+    slow.__package__ = 'toolz.audit'
+    child = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.audit.child')
+    child.__package__ = fast.__name__
+    fast.child = child
+    fast.pipe = object()
+    fast.alias = object()
+    slow.pipe = toolz.pipe
+    slow.alias = toolz.pipe
+    target = types.ModuleType('tlz.audit')
+    expected = {name: object() for name in ('pipe', 'alias', 'child')}
+    target.__dict__.update(expected)
+    calls = []
+
+    def resolve(name):
+        calls.append(name)
+        return {'cytoolz.audit': fast, 'toolz.audit': slow}[name]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(builder, 'import_module', resolve)
+    builder.TlzLoader().exec_module(target)
+    assert all(getattr(target, name) is value for name, value in expected.items())
+    assert calls == ['cytoolz.audit', 'toolz.audit']
+
+
+def test_new_exports_still_use_policy(monkeypatch):
+    fast = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.audit')
+    slow = types.ModuleType('toolz.audit')
+    fast.pipe = object()
+    slow.pipe = toolz.pipe
+    child = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.audit.child')
+    child.__package__ = fast.__name__
+    fast.child = child
+    mirrored = types.ModuleType('tlz.audit.child')
+    modules = {'cytoolz.audit': fast, 'toolz.audit': slow,
+               'tlz.audit.child': mirrored}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(builder, 'import_module', modules.__getitem__)
+    target = types.ModuleType('tlz.audit')
+    builder.TlzLoader().exec_module(target)
+    assert target.pipe is toolz.pipe
+    assert target.child is mirrored
spec.notes: Acceptance tests use synthetic backends through the module's import_module binding, so cytoolz installation is irrelevant. Protection is based on the target namespace at method entry, not the namespace after merging.
spec.question: Make `TlzLoader.exec_module` consistently preserve caller-supplied exports. Every target binding whose name does not begin with `__` and which exists when execution starts must survive by identity, even if the corresponding backend export would normally trigger the `toolz.pipe` override or owned-child-module replacement. Do not import a mirrored child merely to replace one of these protected bindings. Newly supplied backend exports must continue to use the current override and child-mirroring policies, and metadata behavior must remain unchanged. Deliver a unified diff against production files only.
